title: Every Status update starts the Assistant on a fresh conversation, so it stays near-stateless

requirements.text: Clicking Status update in the Mac app ends the Assistant's conversation (copy kept in Assistant/conversations) and starts a fresh one opening on the sweep
requirements.check: eye: relaunch, click Status update twice; second click shows a new conversation, and ~/Library/Application Support/Genlock/Assistant/conversations gains a file

requirements.text: The phone's Status update button does the same, with no new APK: the bridge marks the tell fresh and the app restarts the Assistant on it
A fresh conversation's overview still says what changed since the last status, instead of treating everything as new
requirements.check: node tests/run.mjs (overview delta across conversations case)

requirements.text: The Assistant's rules say it is near-stateless: record as it goes, clear at every natural break, never hold state in conversation; the long-conversation threshold is lowered
A fresh start waits for the Assistant's turn to end, so a reply in progress is never cut off

evidence: node --test mobile/bridge/test/fresh.test.mjs -> 3 pass: STATUS_REQUEST plain text gets fresh:true, 'rank billing first' does not
node tests/run.mjs -> 518/0, incl. new conversation prints 'Same as at the last status:' alpha and 'Nothing has changed since the last status'

Voice.swift assistantRule: 'Stay near-stateless...', 'Clear early and often...'; 'Use your context fully' removed (asserted in testAStatusUpdateStartsTheAssistantFresh); ASSISTANT_LONG_BYTES 250KB in lib/overview.mjs:27
swift test -> 126/0; assistantMayStartFresh false for working/waiting/unheard reply/dictating; fresh tells skipped by takeTells

text: With Remote Control on, each fresh start opens a new remote session in the Claude app
breaks: TJ following the Assistant in claude.ai/code would see a new conversation after every status update

text: Built and tested (node 518/0, swift 126/0, bridge 3/0). Req 1 needs TJ to relaunch the app and click Status update twice. Bridge must be restarted to pick up the fresh flag. Not committed.
